title: feat(plugin-detail): a double-click on the record page details divider resets the column to its default width
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Fixes #36226

Clause-②: no — no public type or accept set; one interaction on an existing control
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 宽屏打开记录整页时，左边字段栏和右边页签之间的分隔线，双击就回到默认宽度 400，并且记住；以前只能拖动或用方向键调。
- 属于「记录页对标 Attio」专题：这张卡的五条里只差「双击复位」这一条，其余四条（可拖的分隔线、拖动范围、按人按对象记住宽度、评论栏不动）此前的记录页改版已经做完，这次在控制台里逐条实测并附了截图。
- 碰到的只是在宽屏记录整页双击分隔线的人；出错最多是双击没反应或宽度不对，拖动和键盘照常能用，这次改动可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- The record full page's pinned left column (the details beside the tabs on a wide full page) already has a divider, `DetailsWidthHandle`, that drags, moves with the arrow keys and Home / End, and keeps the width per reader and per object. A **double-click** on it now keeps `RECORD_PAGE_DETAILS_WIDTH` (400), the same constant the page falls back to when nothing is kept (the console's workspace preference passes it as the fallback; the plugin's own clamp uses it for an absent width). So the reset writes the default as the kept width, and the next record of that object opens at 400.
- The double-click clears any in-flight drag and its preview first, so a press still down when it lands does not go on to preview or commit a width.
- Card items 1, 2, 4 and 5 were already delivered by #36136 and #35890: the divider, its limits, the remembered width, and the comment panel left unchanged. They are measured in the Console below. This PR adds item 3, the double-click reset. The card's own numbers (a right rail of 320, dragged between 280 and 560) describe the rail that #36136 removed. The default reset to here is #35890's 「左栏宽 400」, not a new number.
- README (the package ships it): the record-page section's layout table and its tab-row paragraph now describe today's layout, as read from `RecordPageColumns` and `recordPagePinsDetails`:
  - pinned on a full page whose content is at least 744 px wide (with another tab, and no related table among the fields), the details tab first everywhere else;
  - no right column at any width;
  - one field per row except on a details-only full page;
  - the tab order ends with 动态 last;
  - the divider, with its drag, keys, double-click and host-kept width.

  The old 1120 / 760 px right-column tiers and "there is no tabbed tier" are gone. Two later paragraphs (the related panels' count-first loading, and "One header serves every tier") were not re-measured and are carried to #36493.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`: the `onDoubleClick` on `DetailsWidthHandle`. It commits the unclamped default, never `clamp(400)`, so a narrow window does not store a smaller width as "the default".
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md`: the rewritten table under "One record page, laid out by its width".
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`: the new `it` in the objectstack#35890 describe, with a host stand-in that re-reads its store on every mount.

## Console evidence

This branch's Console (vite) runs against a fresh `examples/app-crm` backend (`--fresh`, seeded). The browser is headless Chromium at 1440×900 @2x, zh-CN, signed in as the seeded admin. The page is 客户 (`crm_account`), a synthesized record page. Readings come from the separator's `aria-valuenow` and the column's measured width.

| Step | 客户 record page | Reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Before the drag | [01-before-drag](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/01-before-drag.png?raw=true) | 400 (max 664 at 1440) |
| After dragging +160 | [02-after-drag](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/02-after-drag.png?raw=true) | 560 |
| Another 客户 record | [03-other-account-keeps-width](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/03-other-account-keeps-width.png?raw=true) | 560, kept |
| A 联系人 (`crm_contact`) record | [04-contact-default](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/04-contact-default.png?raw=true) | 400, the default: the width is kept per reader and per object |
| Back on 客户, double-click | [07-after-double-click](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/07-after-double-click.png?raw=true) | **400** |
| Reload, then the first 客户 record again | (no shot) | 400 and 400: the reset is kept |

![after the double-click: the details column back at 400](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/07-after-double-click.png?raw=true)

**Comment panel.** At 1920×1080 @2x with the comment panel open beside the page, [before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/09-1920-comments-open-before-drag.png?raw=true) and [after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/10-1920-comments-open-after-drag.png?raw=true) a drag of +120: the column goes 400 → 520, then a double-click returns it to 400. The comment panel measures 380 px at each of the three readings. At 1440 with the panel open, the page content is under 744 px, so the page does not pin and there is no divider to drag ([05-comments-open](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/05-comments-open.png?raw=true)): the details are the 「详情」 tab and the panel is still 380.

**Narrowing the window.** At 1280, 1100, 1000, 900, 800, 700 and 600 px wide, the document never scrolls sideways (`scrollWidth` equals `clientWidth` at each). The column stays 400 down to 900, where the divider's max is 412. At 800 and below the page is no longer pinned ([08-narrow-900](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/08-narrow-900.png?raw=true), [08-narrow-800](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/74ac3018d3457fe7270c9df654d1386daf71ebfc/issue-36226/08-narrow-800.png?raw=true)). The only sideways scrollers inside the page are the related lists' own grids, which scroll by design.

**HotCRM's 客户 page: NOT MEASURED live.** The box had about 1 GB of memory free during this run, shared by five devs, and an earlier dev ran out of memory building the crm closure. A static reading of HotCRM `origin/main` (689166c): it authors no record page for `crm_account`. Its only `crm_account` page, `account_workbench`, is a list interface page, and its authored record pages are project, quote, contract, lead and case. So HotCRM's 客户 record page is this same synthesized page and component.

## Tests

`aria-valuenow` on the separator, read from the new test:

| step | before this PR (handler ablated) | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| drag 400 → 520 | 520 | 520 |
| double-click | 520 | **400** |
| move + release after the double-click | n/a (the test is already red) | 400 (no preview, nothing kept) |
| remount from the kept store | n/a | **400** |

```text
anchor count now: 0

AssertionError: expected '520' to be '400' // Object.is equality
      Tests  1 failed | 35 passed (36)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (a35b42507591) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

Each card acceptance line, read on the layout after #36136 and #35890:

- 「拖到头右边栏是 280 和 560」 has no meaning on this layout, because the right rail it measures is gone. The divider now sits between the pinned details column and the tabs. Its limits are a 320 px minimum for the column and room for 400 px of tabs (664 at 1440).
- 「双击分隔线：右边栏回到 320」 becomes: the details column returns to 400, #35890's default.
- 「字段区不足 480 时右边栏自动让出宽度」: the column yields to keep the tabs 400 px, never below 320, and the page unpins below 744 px of content. Measured above, with no sideways page scroll.
- The other lines (another record of the same object keeps the width, another object stays at the default, the comment panel's width is unchanged, the screenshots) are measured above. HotCRM is NOT MEASURED live, for the reason given above.
- Keyboard reset: not added. No separator in `ui/` resets from the keyboard. The record drawer's resize handle and the Gantt splitter both reset on double-click only, so there is no convention to follow.
- A reading, not filed: the pinned details column's `scrollWidth` exceeds its `clientWidth` by 6 px at 1440 and 900. It draws no horizontal scrollbar in this Chromium, and this PR does not touch that layout.

## Verification

Two minutes: on a wide window (content at least 744 px), open any record as a full page. Drag the divider between the fields and the tabs, then double-click it. The fields column snaps back to 400 px. Open another record of the same object and it is still 400.
